data.name: Najmu
data.gender_notes: Najmu is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Najmu means 'star' in Arabic, Urdu and Persian. The name Najmu carries the meaning “Star” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Najmu usually hope their child will grow to embody star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, stars are seen as celestial bodies created by Allah, mentioned in the Quran (82:1-2) and Hadith.
data.etymology: Najmu belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Star.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Najmu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نجم
in_arabic.meaning: النجم الذي يضيء في السماء ليلا النجم الواحد
in_arabic.long_meaning: النجم في اللغة العربية يعني النجم الواحد الذي يظهر في السماء ليلا ويضيء، ويشير إلى الضوء والرؤية الواضحة. ورد ذكر النجوم في القرآن الكريم في عدة سور، منها سورة النجم، وتدل على عظمة خلق الله تعالى وتفاوت درجاتها في السماء.

in_urdu.name: نجم
in_urdu.meaning: وہ ستارہ جو رات کے وقت آسمان پر چمکتا ہے اکیلا ستارہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کی root ن-ج-م سے بنا ہوا، جس کا معنی ہے ستارہ یا وہ جو چمکتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں ستاروں کا ذکر خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن مجید میں سورة النجم میں ستاروں کی قسم کھائی گئی ہے۔ یہ نام بچے کے لیے روشن مستقبل کی دعا کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नज्म
in_hindi.meaning: वह तारा जो रात के समय आकाश में चमकता है अकेला तारा
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द 'नज्म' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है तारा। इस्लामी परंपरा में, तारे आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखते हैं और अक्सर दिव्य मार्गदर्शन के प्रतीक के रूप में देखे जाते हैं। यह नाम बच्चे के लिए एक उज्ज्वल और आशाजनक भविष्य की कामना के रूप में दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نجم
in_pashto.meaning: هغه ستوری چی د شپو په وخت د آسمان په چمکیږي یو ستوری
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې د نجم معنی هغه ستوری ده چی د شپو په وخت د آسمان په چمکیږي. په اسلامی کیلنڈر کې د ستورو ذکر ځانګړی اهمیت لري، په ځانګړي ډول د قرآن کریم په سورت النجم کې د ستورو قسم خوړل شوې ده. دا نوم د ماشوم لپاره د روښانه راتلونکي دعا په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Najmu
in_english.meaning: a shining star in the night sky
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-m', Najmu signifies a single star that shines brightly in the night sky. In Islamic tradition, stars hold spiritual significance and are often seen as symbols of divine guidance. The Quran mentions stars in several chapters, including Surah An-Najm, emphasizing their importance in creation and as signs of Allah's power. The name Najmu conveys wishes for a child to have a bright and promising future, guiding them on their life's path.

data.cultural_impact: The name Najmu holds a significant cultural impact in the Muslim world. Stars have long been considered as celestial bodies of wonder and mystery. In various Islamic cultures, stars are believed to hold spiritual power and influence. They are often mentioned in hadiths and Quranic verses. Najmu, as a star name, echoes the rich Islamic cultural heritage and the fascination for the night sky and its celestial wonders.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the Islamic name Najmu evokes a sense of connection to the divine. Stars have been traditionally seen as spiritual beacons, guiding lost souls towards the right path. The name Najmu is believed to inspire awe and reverence for the wonders of the universe, as well as remind us of the vastness of the cosmos and the corresponding smallness of our earthly selves. It may also bring about a sense of inspiration and motivation to strive towards our goals, like a guiding star in the night sky.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Star" symbolizes Najmu means 'star' in Arabic, Urdu and Persian.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Najmu serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of star.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Najmu was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Najmu carried significant weight in that era.
